headline: Rent a Yacht in BVI
primaryText: Choose your perfect catamaran charter and sail the beautiful British Virgin Islands.
whyItWorks: The aerial shot of a turquoise bay full of moored boats sells the destination at a glance, so the viewer pictures the trip before reading anything. The headline names the exact product and place, which filters for people already considering a BVI sailing holiday. A single clear button with a direct booking verb keeps the next step simple.
